notes.title: Join the Pieced Together Discord!
notes.notes: [p]We're opening up a Discord for Pieced Together and would love to see you there! [/p][p]You'll be able to see [b]exclusive content[/b] and updates about the game before anyone else, tell us what you think about [b]new features[/b] and even [b]suggest ideas[/b] for stickers to put in the game.[/p][p]We'll also be running exclusive playtests so you may get a chance to play the demo before it's out![/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://discord.gg/ppTVnAahpZ" style="button"]Join The Discord[/url][/p]
